name: gsd-only
description: Vanilla + the GSD plugin only: isolates GSD's own contribution before cairn is layered on. Source pinned to buildomator/buildomator@v4.3.1 (tag verified live 2026-07-25 via git ls-remote; formerly published as jnuyens/gsd-plugin), matching the operator's installed plugin cache version. Build uses npm ci: GSD ships a package-lock.json with only two pure-JS devDependencies (ajv, ajv-formats), so the install is deterministic.
